status_reason: Only the main experiment's trial structure is built (fixation, RF and distracter bars, a frame-locked stimulation trigger, sync marks). The paper's result is a change in V4 firing after subthreshold FEF stimulation: it needs a V4 recording, an FEF stimulator, the RF and FEF-threshold mapping paradigms (not built here) and a monkey, and the fixation task itself has no behavioural measure to replicate.

original.citation: Moore, T., & Armstrong, K. M. (2003). Selective gating of visual signals by microstimulation of frontal cortex. Nature, 421(6921), 370-373.
original.experiments: The single experiment: subthreshold FEF stimulation while a monkey fixates, with oriented bars in and outside a V4 neuron's RF (Figs. 2 and 3)

notes: Recording and microstimulation are the lab's: this folder sends the STIM_TRIGGER TTL and sync marks only. A no-stimulation human file (configs/task-demo-human.yaml) shows the display to a person. No participant data.
